description: Call this when a user asks what SpiceFactory has written or built on a topic, such as FDA evidence for AI software, HIPAA architecture, or fleet telemetry. Searches recent essays, case studies, and the main pages. Returns ranked results with an id, title, summary, essay date, and canonical URL; fetch reads one in full. Public, no auth.
